chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from al-Hasan ibn 'Ali ibn Faddal, from 'Ubayd ibn Zurarah, who said:
I said to Abī 'Abdillāh عليه السلام: A man remembered that he had not recited the qunut until he had bowed. He said: Then he said, he should recite the qunut when he raises his head.

key_terms.الرَّجُلُ: the man being asked about in the ruling
key_terms.رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ: he raised his head from bowing
key_terms.لَمْ يَقْنُتْ: he did not perform the qunut
key_terms.يَقْنُتُ: he performs the qunut supplication in prayer

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he forgets qunut until after ruku' in salat?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about one who forgets the qunut before going into ruku'. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that he should make up the qunut after raising his head, indicating that the missed qunut may be performed then.
